title: Security: High-Risk Permissions in Jules-Archivist Workflow
body: The `.github/workflows/Jules-Archivist.yml` workflow requests `contents: write` permissions and executes `git push origin --delete "$BRANCH"`. This capability to delete remote branches poses a significant security risk if not strictly validated and monitored. Recommended Action: Downgrade permissions or implement manual approval steps.

title: Security: Unverified External Dependency in Assessment Generator
body: The `.github/workflows/Jules-Assessment-Generator.yml` workflow interacts with `jules.googleapis.com` and sends repository context to this external API. It also requests write permissions for PRs and issues. This presents a supply chain security risk. Recommended Action: Audit the external dependency and ensure robust authentication and data handling.

title: Ops: Global Package Installation in CI
body: The `.github/workflows/Jules-Assessment-Remediator.yml` workflow uses `npm install -g @google/jules`. Installing global packages in CI is bad practice due to potential environment conflicts and lack of version isolation. Recommended Action: Switch to local dependencies or `npx`.

title: CI: Pipeline Instability and Syntax Errors
body: Review of `workflow_runs_tools.txt` indicates persistent failures in `CI Standard` and `Jules-Control-Tower` workflows, likely due to syntax errors (`fix(ci): fix indentation...`). This instability blocks reliable development. Recommended Action: Prioritize fixing workflow syntax and configuration.
